procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (51 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 0 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-52 (labels 8, 18, 19 printed with a comma — '8,', '18,', '19,' — still the labels, v1.4 §14.1); no gaps or duplicates. Answer side 1-13, [match block], 15-52 — every key by printed number; no displaced key. Difficulty per question: easy 24, average 9, difficult 11, untagged 8.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 72 (heading, LO) 73-76; A pdf 170 (heading, keys 1-4) 171-173.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-13; s3 '14. Match the following with suitable answers: easy)' q14 (8 rows); s4 T/F q15-22 (no answer spaces printed); s5 one mark q23-30 vsa (heading untagged, stems untagged -> 8 x 'no difficulty tag'); s6 two marks q31-41 sa; s7 three marks q42-47 sa; s8 four marks q48-52 la.

KEY SIDE ANALYSED FIRST: the survey's 'missing 8/18/19' were labels printed with a comma (evs_auto now accepts '8,' as a label; regression evs-4-02..16 identical apart from timestamps); key 14 is the unnumbered match block. Nothing displaced.
q14 match key: shortened right-hand items, one column-B item used twice and one unused, one implausible pair -> flagged for review. Tags without '(' read (q14 'easy)', q44 'family?(Average)').
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_17.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
